blind_target.title: Altruism and indirect reciprocity: The interaction of person and situation in prosocial behavior
blind_target.evidence_quote: Towards the latter goal, we sought to conduct a conceptual replication of Simpson and Willer (2008) [39] to investigate if SVO has different relationships with decisionmaking in public versus private conditions.
blind_target.outcome_quote: Notably, this analysis was underpowered and we cannot draw definitive conclusions whether SVO relates to responses to observation.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: Authors explicitly say the SVO analysis was underpowered and cannot adjudicate the response-to-observation finding, despite some same-direction descriptive results.

luna_triage.reason: The authors explicitly describe a conceptual replication of Simpson and Willer (2008) and test whether social value orientation relates to responses to observation.
